text: 人間の臭いを嫌うから — because they dislike the smell of humans

text: 出稼ぎの漁師が長期滞在する — fishermen working away from home stay long-term

text: 技術ばっか磨いてたからな — kept honing that technique

text: オレを育ててくれたわけだから — since she's the one who raised me

english: on one's own, arbitrarily, without asking

text: ちょっと口うるさいけど — though she's a bit nagging

text: 一か月ちょいかな… — about a month or so, I guess

text: 今度はジンを探しに行くのね — this time you'll go search for Jin

text: どちらかのトランクが紛失してると困るから — in case either suitcase gets lost

english: to use extensively, to be well-practiced from heavy use

english: an apology, a token of apology

text: それよりはましか — that's better than that, I guess
